mission: Achieve 100% Green Test Suite - Zero Compromises
strategic_intent: Make test suite pass 100% green with zero workarounds, zero skips (except legitimate slow tests), and zero broken windows. Fix root causes systematically using parallel specialized agents to conserve Opus tokens for architectural oversight.

what_makes_a_shining_example: Tests that catch real bugs, not testing implementation details
Fast feedback loops (<10 min for full suite)
Clear test names that document expected behavior
Comprehensive coverage of edge cases (NECESSARY pattern)
Resilient to environment changes (mocked external dependencies)
when_tests_themselves_are_wrong: Testing private implementation details instead of public API
Overly brittle mocks that break on refactoring
Tests that require complex setup indicating poor design
Long-running E2E tests better suited for integration tier
Tests with hard-coded absolute paths or environment assumptions
Duplicate test logic across multiple files
architectural_philosophy.high_altitude_perspective: A test suite is the heartbeat of autonomous development. When it's green, we can deploy with confidence. When it's flaky, we waste hours debugging phantom issues. The goal is not '100% coverage' but '100% confidence'. Some tests need deletion, not fixing. Some need complete rewrites. This mission takes that high-level view.

phases.title: Fix Critical Blockers Preventing Clean Test Runs
phases.description: Fix worker crashes and hangs that prevent accurate test result collection

tasks.title: Fix regex catastrophic backtracking in test_error_parser.py
tasks.description: Worker crashes on test_parse_log_with_very_long_single_line due to regex backtracking on 10KB+ lines. Add line length limit (e.g., 5000 chars) or use non-greedy regex. This is blocking accurate test result collection - highest priority.
acceptance_criteria: No regex backtracking catastrophe on long lines
Full test run completes without worker crashes

tasks.title: Verify regex fix with comprehensive edge cases
tasks.description: Test that regex fix handles: (1) very long single lines (10KB+), (2) moderate lines (1KB), (3) short lines, (4) empty lines, (5) lines with special regex chars
acceptance_criteria: No performance regression on normal lines
Clear error messages for rejected long lines

tasks.title: Fix distributed locks test causing worker hangs
tasks.description: Worker gw1 crashed on distributed locks test. Add proper timeouts to lock acquisition, use faster heartbeat intervals for testing (0.1s instead of 2s). Ensure all threads join with timeout.
acceptance_criteria: No worker crashes on lock tests

phases.title: Auditor-Led Strategic Analysis of Remaining 67 Failures
phases.description: Use auditor agent to categorize ALL remaining failures by root cause, identify patterns, and propose architectural solutions (not band-aids)

tasks.title: Comprehensive audit of all 67 remaining test failures
tasks.description: Run full test suite with detailed failure output. Categorize failures by: (1) Missing implementations, (2) Incorrect test assumptions, (3) Environmental issues (git, filesystem), (4) Schema evolution issues, (5) Performance/timeout issues, (6) Tests that should be deleted. Generate prioritized fix list with estimated impact. Identify systemic issues requiring architectural changes.
acceptance_criteria: All 67 failures categorized with root cause
Prioritized fix list (P0: critical, P1: high, P2: medium)
Identification of tests that need deletion vs fixing
Estimated tokens and time for each category

tasks.title: Identify tests that should be deleted, not fixed
tasks.description: High-level analysis: which tests are testing implementation details instead of behavior? Which tests are duplicates? Which tests require unreasonable setup indicating design smell? Propose deletions with justification. Apply 'shining example' criteria from architectural philosophy.
acceptance_criteria: List of 5-10 tests proposed for deletion with justification
Analysis of what each test was trying to verify
Recommendation for alternative coverage if needed
No deletion of tests covering genuine edge cases

phases.title: Parallel Specialized Agent Execution (Conserve Opus Tokens)
phases.description: Deploy 5-8 parallel agents to fix categorized issues simultaneously, using Tier 2 models for tactical fixes while Opus orchestrates

tasks.title: Fix git validation test failures (E2E mocking issues)
tasks.description: Fix 2 git validation failures caused by missing git executable mocks or incorrect branch assumptions in E2E tests. Add proper fixture setup, mock subprocess.run for git commands with realistic outputs.

tasks.title: Fix PredictionLog validation in weekly_retraining_scheduler
tasks.description: Fix the 1 error in test_weekly_retraining_scheduler.py caused by PredictionLog schema validation. Ensure all PredictionLog instances use correct schema, update any outdated .dict() calls to .model_dump().

tasks.title: Fix missing trained model fixtures for model tests
tasks.description: Fix 1 model loading failure by creating proper test fixtures for trained models. Use mock models or pre-trained small models for testing, ensure fixtures are lightweight and fast to load.
acceptance_criteria: Tests don't require external model files

tasks.title: Fix TrainingSample Pydantic validation error
tasks.description: Fix 1 dataset validation error caused by incorrect TrainingSample Pydantic model usage. Ensure all fields are correctly typed, use .model_validate() instead of .parse_obj(), update to Pydantic V2 patterns.

tasks.title: Update all .dict() → .model_dump() (26 deprecation warnings)
tasks.description: Systematically update all Pydantic V1 patterns to V2: .dict() → .model_dump(), .parse_obj() → .model_validate(), .schema() → .model_json_schema(). Fix 26 deprecation warnings across monitoring service and other modules.

tasks.title: Fix remaining categorized failures from audit report
tasks.description: Address remaining failures based on auditor's prioritized list. Focus on P0 and P1 issues first. Use parallel agents for independent failures. Follow root-cause fixing, no workarounds.
acceptance_criteria: P2 failures fixed or documented for future work

phases.title: Optimize Test Suite Performance (<10 Min Target)
phases.description: Make fast feedback loops a reality - target full suite in <10 minutes

tasks.title: Profile test suite to identify slowest 20 tests
tasks.description: Run test suite with --durations=20 to identify slowest tests. Categorize slow tests as: (1) Legitimately slow (E2E, integration) → mark with @pytest.mark.slow, (2) Unnecessarily slow (long sleeps) → optimize, (3) Redundant slow tests → delete.
acceptance_criteria: List of 20 slowest tests with timings

tasks.title: Optimize unnecessarily slow tests (long sleeps, inefficient mocks)
tasks.description: Apply optimizations from TEST_SUITE_FIX_ACTION_PLAN.md: replace long sleeps with faster intervals for testing, use mocks instead of real operations, add asyncio timeouts. Do NOT mark tests as @pytest.mark.slow unless they are genuinely E2E/integration tests.
acceptance_criteria: All sleeps have clear justification comments

tasks.title: Mark legitimate E2E/integration tests with @pytest.mark.slow
tasks.description: Mark truly slow E2E/integration tests (>30s) with @pytest.mark.slow so they can be run separately in CI. Document why each test is legitimately slow. Ensure fast unit tests run by default.
acceptance_criteria: Each marked test has justification comment
Default test run (without --slow) completes in <5 min
CI can run slow tests separately

phases.title: Constitutional Compliance & Quality Gates
phases.description: Verify all 6 articles are enforced, zero workarounds remain

tasks.title: Audit all @pytest.mark.skip to ensure legitimate reasons
tasks.description: Grep for all @pytest.mark.skip in tests/. For each skip: (1) Verify it has clear reason, (2) Verify reason is legitimate (external dependency unavailable, not 'test is broken'), (3) Propose fixes for any 'broken' skips, (4) Delete skips that are no longer relevant.
acceptance_criteria: No skips due to 'test is broken' or 'TODO'
Skips only for genuine external dependencies
List of skips that can be removed

tasks.title: Verify Article VI (TDD) compliance across test suite
tasks.description: Validate that all tests follow TDD patterns: tests were written first, tests cover NECESSARY pattern (Normal/Edge/Security/Spec/Accessibility/Resilience/Year-round), no implementation-detail testing. Generate report of any violations.
acceptance_criteria: All tests have clear arrange-act-assert structure
Report of any TDD pattern violations

tasks.title: Final audit: zero broken windows, zero workarounds
tasks.description: Comprehensive audit to ensure: (1) No @pytest.mark.xfail, (2) No try/except pass, (3) No 'TODO: fix this test', (4) No commented-out assertions, (5) No hardcoded absolute paths, (6) No flaky tests. Generate constitutional compliance report.
acceptance_criteria: Test suite is a 'shining example' by our criteria

phases.title: 100% Green Verification & Documentation
phases.description: Final full test run, confirm 100% pass rate, document learnings

tasks.title: Run full test suite on clean checkout - verify 100% green
tasks.description: Run python run_tests.py --run-all on clean checkout (no cached fixtures, no artifacts). Verify: (1) 100% pass rate (no failures, no errors), (2) Completes in <10 minutes, (3) No worker crashes, (4) No deprecation warnings (except external libs), (5) All skips are legitimate.

tasks.title: Generate comprehensive test suite excellence report
tasks.description: Document the journey from 98.8% → 100%, architectural decisions made, tests deleted vs fixed, performance improvements, constitutional compliance validation. Include 'What makes this a shining example' section. Store as ADR.

checkpoints.criteria: All worker crashes resolved, test run completes without hangs

checkpoints.prompt: Review auditor's categorization of 67 failures and proposed deletions. Approve strategic approach before parallel agent execution.

checkpoints.criteria: All categorized failures fixed, test pass rate >99.5%
Zero broken windows, zero workarounds, 100% constitutional compliance

metadata.parallelization_strategy: Phase 3 tasks can run in parallel (5-8 agents), conserving Opus tokens for orchestration
